title: How I use LLMs to learn complex topics
summary: A personal blog post sharing practical strategies for using Large Language Models as effective learning tools for complex topics, moving beyond simple Q&A to structured learning workflows.
problem_solved: How to effectively leverage LLMs as learning companions rather than just search engines or answer machines.
why_valuable: Provides actionable frameworks and techniques for self-directed learners to accelerate understanding of complex subjects using AI.
